headline.title: OpenRouter more than doubles valuation to $1.3B in a year
headline.summary: OpenRouter has secured $113 million in a Series B funding round led by CapitalG, boosting its valuation to $1.3 billion. The company reports a fivefold increase in usage over the past six months, reflecting a growing demand for multi-AI-model solutions.

articles.title: Why the Vatican Invited Anthropic to the Pope’s AI Encyclical Presentation
articles.summary: The Vatican invited Anthropic to participate in the presentation of Pope Leo's first encyclical, highlighting a significant collaboration between the Church and the tech industry. This partnership aims to address ethical considerations surrounding artificial intelligence.

articles.title: What Pope Leo XIV’s First Encyclical Says About the Power of AI
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical, Magnifica Humanitas, criticizes the concentration of technological power among a small number of global entities, highlighting concerns about the ethical implications of artificial intelligence. The document calls for a more equitable distribution of technological advancements to benefit all of humanity.

articles.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Early Bird ticket rates end May 29
articles.summary: Early Bird ticket rates for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will end on May 29 at 11:59 p.m. PT, allowing attendees to save up to $410 on their passes. Interested participants can register now to attend the event in San Francisco.

articles.title: This startup is betting India’s gig economy can train the world’s robots
articles.summary: Human Archive, a startup founded by researchers from UC Berkeley and Stanford, is leveraging India's gig economy by employing workers to wear camera-equipped caps and sensors to gather essential real-world training data for AI and robotics. This initiative aims to support the growing demand for high-quality training data in the robotics sector.

articles.title: Sundar Pichai on AI, the future of search, and what’s happening to the web
articles.summary: In a recent interview, Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai discussed the impact of AI on the future of search and the evolving landscape of the web, following the Google I/O developer conference. This marks the fifth consecutive year Pichai has participated in this post-I/O conversation.

articles.title: It’s time to address the looming crisis in entry-level work.
articles.summary: The article discusses the potential crisis in entry-level job opportunities as artificial intelligence continues to evolve, despite overall stable employment figures in developed countries. It highlights concerns about the diminishing availability of entry-level positions, which could impact career progression for new workers.

articles.title: Rethinking organizational design in the age of agentic AI
articles.summary: A recent report highlights a significant gap between organizations' ambitions to adopt agentic AI and their current operational capabilities, with 85% aiming for agentic status within three years, yet 76% lacking the necessary infrastructure. Key barriers include insufficient readiness in personnel, processes, and workflows to support this transition.

articles.title: 7 Ways to Get So Good at AI, People Will Think You Are AI
articles.summary: The article outlines seven strategies for mastering AI skills, including enhancing chatbot performance and refining prompt optimization. These techniques aim to help individuals become proficient in AI technologies and improve their overall effectiveness in the field.

articles.title: Uber president says AI spending is getting ‘harder to justify’
articles.summary: Uber's president, Andrew Macdonald, stated that the company is struggling to justify its AI spending after depleting its annual budget just four months into 2026. He expressed concerns over the lack of meaningful returns on investments, particularly regarding the rising token consumption for Claude Code.

articles.title: Universal Music Group and TikTok renew agreement to combat unauthorized AI music
articles.summary: Universal Music Group and TikTok have renewed their agreement to address unauthorized use of music generated by AI. This partnership aims to enhance content moderation policies to protect intellectual property rights in the evolving digital landscape.

articles.title: Quiz: Will AI Destroy Your Career?
articles.summary: A new interactive quiz explores the potential impact of AI on various careers, allowing users to assess whether their job is at risk of being replaced by automation. The quiz provides insights into which professions may thrive or decline in the face of advancing AI technologies.
